text: The legs are ASYMMETRIC and the output must not pretend otherwise. Hover has no public API and no credentials exist in any tree, so a uniform plan-apply-verify would overpromise on the leg that carries the estate.

ST0003's ratified Done clause in info.md names four things -- the schema and parse-time validation, infra check, infra init, and absorbing the standalone mail spec -- and none of these is among them.
